title: Christening
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Pam and Jim prepare for their daughter Cece's christening, which unexpectedly becomes a larger event with many coworkers attending. Michael struggles with not being chosen as Cece's godfather but insists on celebrating the occasion with everyone. The church service includes prayers and a humorous sales pitch from Dwight. Later, Michael decides to stay on a bus headed to Mexico despite concerns from coworkers, while Jim and others search for the missing baby Cece. The episode concludes with Michael and Andy insisting the bus stop in Tennessee and Erin arriving to pick them up, as most guests leave the church to see a movie suggested by Kevin.
